content.comment_body: Hello, what are the pros and cons of installing a program on an SD card instead of directly on the [product_name]? Can someone assist me?

In my view, the only benefit is for cases where the [product_name] isn't networked and the programmer can't reach it directly. The program can then be sent to the customer on an SD card, allowing them to update the [product_name] themselves. Otherwise, I mainly see downsides.
What about copy protection? If the program runs from an SD card, the customer could replace the [product_name] and simply swap the SD card.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are evaluating the pros and cons of storing programs on an SD card versus the internal memory of a [product_name]. The main advantage is easier updates or replacements when remote access is required. On the other hand, most users see more disadvantages, such as higher complexity and potential reliability issues compared to direct installation. Some also mention copy protection and simple hardware replacement by moving the SD card as possible benefits.
analysis.user_expectations: A user seeks information on the advantages and disadvantages of installing programs using an SD card for [product_name] devices, with the goal of simplifying updates and possibly improving security or device replacement options.
